Check Manager.description: If the identity has a manager, that manager reviews the access. Otherwise the fallback governance group is the reviewer.

attributes.description: {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}'s job title changed from "{{$.trigger.changes[0].oldValue}}" to "{{$.trigger.changes[0].newValue}}". No manager is assigned, so this review was routed to the fallback governance group. Review their current access and revoke anything that is no longer appropriate for the new role.
attributes.name: Mover access review — {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}

Create Governance Group Certification.description: Creates a one-week identity certification for the mover, assigned to the configured governance group, and activates it immediately. Built-in campaign emails notify the group members.

attributes.description: {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}'s job title changed from "{{$.trigger.changes[0].oldValue}}" to "{{$.trigger.changes[0].newValue}}". Review their current access and revoke anything that is no longer appropriate for the new role.
attributes.name: Mover access review — {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}

Create Manager Certification.description: Creates a one-week identity certification for the mover, assigned to their manager, and activates it immediately.

attributes.body:
Hello {{$.getManagerIdentity.attributes.displayName}},
 
{{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}'s job title changed from {{$.trigger.changes[0].oldValue}} to {{$.trigger.changes[0].newValue}}.
 
A one-week access review has been assigned to you. Please complete it in Identity Security Cloud and revoke any access that is no longer appropriate.
 
Campaign: Mover access review — {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}}
 
Thank you
attributes.subject: Access review required: {{$.getIdentity.attributes.displayName}} job title changed

Email Manager.description: Notifies the manager that a mover access review is waiting for them, including the previous and new job title.

Get Identity.description: Loads the identity whose job title changed so the workflow can certify their access and resolve their manager.

Get Manager Identity.description: Loads the mover's manager so the notification can be sent to their email address. If the manager identity cannot be loaded, the review is routed to the fallback governance group.

variables.description: Governance group that reviews the mover's access when no manager is assigned. Replace YOUR_GOVERNANCE_GROUP_ID with the workgroup ID from Admin > Governance Groups.
variables.name: Governance Group ID

Set Configuration.description: Tenant-specific settings. Set the fallback governance group before enabling the workflow.

name: Mover Micro-Certification
description: When an identity's job title changes, assign a one-week micro-certification of their access to the manager, or to a configured governance group if no manager is found. Do not import this export as-is; rebuild it with the prospect.
